defs.def: to mention sth as a reason or an example, or in order to support what you are saying 提及（原因）；举出（示例）；列举

ex.s: Use your notes and cite examples to explain what you think about the characters.
ex.t: 使用您的笔记并引用示例来解释您对角色的看法。

ex.s: Adam Turner, a school head teacher in the UK, cites this as one of the most appealing aspects of the recently added Chinese course.
ex.t: 英国学校校长亚当·特纳（Adam Turner）认为，这是最近新增的中文课程最吸引人的方面之一。

defs.def: to speak or write the exact words from a book, an author, etc. 引用；引述；援引

ex.s: A recent example cited on the website is that one of the testing companies compare / compares the talents of twins Bobby and Benny.
ex.t: 网站上最近引用的一个例子是，其中一家测试公司比较了双胞胎 Bobby 和 Benny 的才能。

ex.s: Like any academic writing, a good news article should cite its sources such as personal eyewitness accounts, interviews, videos, or other published articles.
ex.t: 与任何学术文章一样，好新闻文章应引用其来源，例如个人目击者陈述、采访、视频或其他已发表的文章。

ex.s: The first time that she had to write an essay, her tutor explained that she must acknowledge what other people had said if she cited their ideas, but that he mainly wanted to know what she thought!
ex.t: 她第一次写文章时，她的导师解释说，如果她引用别人的想法，她必须承认他们说的话，但他主要想知道她的想法！

defs.def: to order sb to appear in court; to name sb officially in a legal case 传唤；传讯
to mention sb officially or publicly because they deserve special praise 嘉奖；表彰；表扬

chunks.cn: 一个 实例 提及
